objective: Implement the agreed Vantyr roadmap in reviewed and verified increments
completionRule: Record verification evidence and material limitations before marking done. Device hardware checks remain unverified until executed.

items.title: Reliable deletion and stable fleet sorting
acceptance: Deletion awaits API completion; failure retains selection and inline errors
Online-first natural name order with stable ID tie-breaker and persisted sort
Removal accessible from grid and list with named confirmation
evidence: 9 focused fleet regression tests passed; frontend build passed
Shared T3 preview rendered natural online-first fleet order and per-device removal controls
Delayed/failing deletion and sidebar synchronization covered by DOM integration tests
limitations: Live-server deletion and cross-dashboard broadcast remain lifecycle milestone work
Additional last-seen/added/version sort choices remain follow-up work
T3 browser automation intermittently loses attachment; interaction verification also covered by DOM tests

items.title: Recall scoped search, links, dates and gaps
acceptance: Stale requests cannot replace current query/device/monitor results
Shared links and navigation restore day/time/monitor
Gap display distinguishes captured time from playhead and missing images

items.title: Complete paginated Recall history
acceptance: Stable timestamp and ID cursor with completeness metadata
More than 3000 frames navigable through newest recording
Invalid cursors rejected; existing API consumers preserved
evidence: PostgreSQL integration passed using temporary fixtures: 5003 tied-time frames, 3000-page boundary, monitor/device isolation, 5004 retained search hits
Frontend paging helper: 4 tests passed including >3000 frames, cancellation, overlap, repeating cursors, legacy completeness
limitations: Frontend playback integration still in progress
Pagination freezes filter bounds but is not a database snapshot; completeness is result traversal, not capture coverage

items.title: Reset installation and lifecycle synchronization
acceptance: Replacement retains identity/history and rotates credentials
Removal updates other dashboards and handles reconnect races
Stored blob cleanup verified

items.title: Device-owned module permissions
acceptance: Only authenticated local actions enable optional modules
Remote stop persists across reconnect/reboot with revision ordering
Collection, execution, upload and service worker paths enforce permissions

items.title: Mobile navigation and keyboard-aware flows
acceptance: No unintended horizontal scroll at 320/375/390px
Touch targets, dialogs, rotation and software keyboard remain usable
iOS and Android checks tracked separately from emulation

items.title: Exclusive remote control and input lifecycle
acceptance: Control lease prevents concurrent operators
Blur/cancel/disconnect/expiry releases held inputs
Device acknowledgment and revocation produce clear feedback

items.title: Correct remote input geometry
acceptance: Secondary and negative-origin monitors map correctly
Mixed DPI/portrait/resizing verified
Second viewer cannot silently switch controller display

items.title: Mobile remote desktop interaction
acceptance: Direct-touch and trackpad gestures verified
Software keyboard/IME/Unicode and shortcut toolbar work
Fullscreen and local zoom/pan remain usable

items.title: Recall search context and saved moments
acceptance: Scope/date/app filters and paginated results
Jump-to-time, bookmarks/notes and saved searches restore exact context
Repeated captures grouped without losing distinct matches

items.title: Evidence-linked Recall summaries and coverage
acceptance: Summary entries link to underlying recordings
Inference and missing coverage are explicit
Retention coverage and recording health available

items.title: Scoped bidirectional text clipboard
acceptance: Explicit device permission and bounded payloads
Both directions and denied browser access verified

items.title: Measure and optimize remote media transport
acceptance: Baseline LAN and constrained WAN latency/FPS/bandwidth/CPU measured
Encoded video candidate compared with MJPEG under same conditions
Relay deployment, synchronized audio and recovery considered before selection

items.title: Batch fleet summaries and saved views
acceptance: Large fleets have consistent status without per-row request storms
Favorites and saved filters survive reload/removal
Health alerts deduplicated and actionable

items.title: Storage accounting and retention cleanup
acceptance: Reported usage agrees with database/files
Retention cleanup reconciles orphan files
Failures visible with safe retry

items.title: Backup restore and diagnostic tools
acceptance: Backup restored into clean instance and verified
Diagnostic bundle excludes credentials and captured private content by default
